about: Experiments in other members' folders, set in the lab's language by the designer. The folder is only read; the header and the layout are the designer's (lab/README.md, The build).

experiments.title: The building, in three frames
experiments.tries: The talk's 43-second animation M01 told on paper in three stills, frozen on its own clock, with the words that were on screen; nothing redrawn.

experiments.question: Does the story survive without the motion? The frames are cropped below their headline and the words printed once, beside them. Is the opening (one way in, a corridor that splits) missed?

experiments.title: The building, in one long image
experiments.tries: M01 as one image the eye travels down: each walk a line, people above, agents below, the time and words down the left.

experiments.question: Does one image carry a 43-second story? Short lines that stop against red ones that do not: clear at a glance, or too busy? Frames (LAB 02) or one image?
